title: Choose the Security Print composition
question: Pick the layout COVENANT should use across desktop and mobile. Every option keeps the same verified evidence and wallet actions.

options.label: Split Instrument
options.thesis: The obligation and credit draw face each other across one central proof seal.
options.viewport: A monumental 5 USDC to proof to 4 CTC relationship dominates the first view, with the causal record beneath it.
options.risk: The wide split needs careful mobile reflow.

options.label: Evidence Ledger
options.thesis: One continuous security document makes all six causal links visible at once.
options.viewport: The six-step proof rail runs from 5 USDC at the left edge through the central seal to 4 CTC at the right edge.
options.risk: Dense horizontal evidence needs deliberate small-screen stacking.

options.label: Proof Dossier
options.thesis: An editorial introduction sits beside a numbered proof instrument with public evidence always in view.
options.viewport: The left column explains the facility while the right column carries the six-stage causal record and proof seals.
options.risk: The document language needs crisp interaction cues so actions remain obvious.
